profile.headline: Software Engineer @ JPMorganChase
profile.summary: Hi there! I'm an enthusiastic and highly motivated computer science professional with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. My passion lies in exploring new technologies and staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in the field. I thrive on the opportunity to expand my knowledge and skills through continuous learning. With a strong foundation in computer science principles, I am well-equipped to tackle complex challenges and deliver innovative solutions. I am driven by a curiosity for discovering new possibilities and enjoy leveraging emerging technologies to create practical and impactful solutions. As a dedicated learner, I constantly seek out opportunities to enhance my skill set and contribute to the ever-evolving world of technology. Let's connect and explore exciting possibilities together!

positions.description: Skills: Java · SDET · Selenium · Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) · Jenkins · CI/CD

positions.title: Amazon Prime Now Associate
positions.description:
• Fulfill Whole Foods orders for Amazon Prime customers in Austin

• Ensure that all items are packed effectively for safe transport to the customer

• Identify and offer acceptable replacements for unavailable items

• Maintain well-stocked PPE and supply inventory

• Frequently sanitize work stations and shopping carts for safe order prepping during the COVID-19 pandemic

positions.title: Localization QA Tester
positions.description:
Create and manage glossaries, style guides, and other linguistic and cultural assets.
Qualify a variety of products and services through both manual and automated UI testing
Drive linguistic bugs resolution and communicate localizability, functional, and layout issues promptly to the product manager
Provide feedback and recommendations on product and UX design, and flag potential cultural sensitivity issues.

positions.title: Dental Assistant
positions.description:
- Educated patients by giving oral hygiene, plaque control and postoperative instructions.
- Performed general chair-side duties to assist with various procedures, including general, endo and oral surgery.
- Assisted dentists by passing instruments, suctioning intraoral fluids, adding water and mixing materials for fillings, casts and impressions.

projects.title: Handwritten Digit Recognition
projects.description:
Developed a neural network to classify handwritten digits using the MNIST dataset, achieving high accuracy.
Implemented feedforward, backpropagation, and regularization to optimize performance.
Built a GUI for real-time digit input and recognition.

projects.title: Stock Market Dashboard
projects.description:
Built a Next.js  dashboard with live streaming prices, advanced search, and interactive candlestick charts
Automated AI insights, and daily summary emails using Inngest workflows and Google Gemini API, with CodeRabbit for AI-driven code review and documentation.
Integrated MongoDB and Better-Auth for secure, scalable data handling and deployed globally on Vercel.
